mentions.name: RunSecret
mentions.description: RunSecret is an open-source CLI that makes working with secrets during local development easier and more secure. It replaces static secrets in environment variables and .env files with "secret references", which are resolved at application startup from the user's secret vault of choice. It is cloud/vault agnostic, requires no code changes, makes .env files safe to share across a team, and redacts secrets from application output to reduce accidental leaks. AWS Secrets Manager support is well baked in, Azure KeyVault support is in progress, and the goal is to support all major secret vaults. Inspired by the 1Password CLI but built as a free, open-source, universal solution.
mentions.problem: Manually managed .env files with static secrets get unwieldy in team settings, cause gotchas with git-ignored env files, and risk accidental secret leaks during local development.
mentions.source_excerpt: RunSecret is a CLI that replaces your static secrets with “secret references” in your ENV VARs (or .env files). These references are then replaced when your application starts up by reaching out to your secret vault of choice - making your .env safe to share across your whole team and removing a slew of gotchas when you use git ignored env files. Even better RunSecret redacts any instance of these secrets from your application output, reducing your chances for accidental leaks.
